body.name: v0.9
body.body:
This stable release of the template greatly improves the overall responsiveness of the template when loading while continuing to support the features introduced in previous v0.8.x minor releases. 

## What's Changed
* Fix theme toggle issue by defining browserPref before use by @ferrolho in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3142
* Update .gitignore to prevent manual update site from fail to build using Github actions by @quangbhdang in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3171
* _includes/footer.html: Fix site last updated template by @hosiet in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3203
* Add INSPIRE-HEP icon by @Gabri110 in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3221
* Fix Disqus comments integration by ensuring the include statement is … by @vigneshragupathy in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3231
* Making it easier to add other themes and adding the 'air' and 'dark' themes from Minimal Mistakes by @Gabri110 in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3236
* Fix local dev URL issues by reverting PR #3029 and correcting Docker config by @ITX351 in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3290
* fix: use https instead of http by @thiswillbeyourgithub in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3339
* feat: add mastodon share button by @thiswillbeyourgithub in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3347
* _includes/head.html: Drop useless meta http-equiv="cleartype" tag by @hosiet in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3354
* navicon: Use span instead of div inside button element by @hosiet in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3356
* _includes/head.html: Remove meta tags HandheldFriendly, MobileOptimized by @hosiet in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3358
* Fix typo in README.md regarding DevContainer by @sandan in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3382
* fix: hamburger menu theme switching by @jarrensj in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3387
* Add SSRN and Zotero "social media" by @lukestein in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3393
* Do not enable duplicated bottom margin/padding when js is enabled by @hosiet in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3391
* add supprt for more themes by @Geordanny1 in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3437
* Selected masthead by @Geordanny1 in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3439
* fix: selected mast head can become black on black in dark mode by @thiswillbeyourgithub in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3451
* images/manifest.json: Generate fields dynamically by @hosiet in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3554
* docs: fix README Linux installation wording by @oozan in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3563
* docs: fix maintainer sentence grammar by @oozan in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3564
* docs: fix missing article in README by @oozan in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3565
* docs: fix README command wording by @oozan in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3566
* fix: avoid footer overlap with custom footer widgets by @oozan in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3568
* fix: load comment provider scripts from shared scripts partial by @oozan in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3567

## New Contributors
* @ferrolho made their first contribution in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3142
* @quangbhdang made their first contribution in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3171
* @Gabri110 made their first contribution in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3221
* @vigneshragupathy made their first contribution in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3231
* @ITX351 made their first contribution in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3290
* @thiswillbeyourgithub made their first contribution in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3339
* @sandan made their first contribution in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3382
* @jarrensj made their first contribution in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3387
* @lukestein made their first contribution in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3393
* @Geordanny1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3437
* @oozan made their first contribution in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3563

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/compare/v0.8.4...v0.9

body.name: v0.8.4
body.body:
This stable version of the template adds support [Mermaid diagrams](https://mermaid.js.org/) and [Plotly](https://plotly.com/javascript/) via Markdown as code blocks. Examples of their syntax and rendering can be found in the [guide on the demo website](https://academicpages.github.io/markdown/).

## What's Changed
* Fix handling of favicon by @hosiet in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2811
* update readme file by @librautoo in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2814

* added chmod to docu and connection_pool to gemfile by @adriandavidauer in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2981
* Adding academia.org to the homepage sidebar and emphasizing the need for a public repo by @msk-nightly in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/3004

body.name: v0.8.3
body.body:
This stable version of the template recognizes the layout of `_sass` in support of [themes](https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/wiki/Customizing-the-theme-of-your-site). This version includes the default 'light mode' theme along with a new dark mode theme.

## What's Changed
* Fix typo in build-essential package name. by @dgrahn in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2096
* Fix #1920 by allowing text to wrap by @dgrahn in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2097
* Add support to semantic scholar in author profile by @thiagorr162 in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2122
* Support for slide links in publication pages by @saravan2 in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2126
* Fix broken analytics default in `_config.yml`  by @manuelhaussmann in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2134
* Add Chinese (both simplified and traditional) to ui-text.yml for Issue #404 by @YanY-Henry in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2144
* README Update: Adds commands for MacOS by @zarela in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2193
* fix: the correct url of lastfm by @02hyc in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2376
* Fixing YouTube URL generation in author-profile.html by @edbrito-swdev in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2419
* Add a dockerfile by @abcsds in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2441
* Fix custom comments appearing at bottom of page by @Samir-Rashid in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2445
* Fix toc crop (#221) by @Samir-Rashid in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2450
* Fix padding misalignment by @Samir-Rashid in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2451

* Update Dockerfile #2488  by @zoelesv in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2489
* Slides URL fix in "archive-single.html" includes template by @opasche in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2535
* Add `scopus` in academic websites by @dtortorella in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2551
* Fix typo in Zhihu URL protocol in `_includes/author-profile.html` by @TankTechnology in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2611
* fix: typo by @mecaneer23 in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2627

* add: docker command related instructions for Windows users by @FahimFBA in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2688
* fix: typo and extra line break by @FahimFBA in https://github.com/academicpages/academicpages.github.io/pull/2690
